selected_script.angle: scrubbing a grease-clogged splatter screen with a dish brush just pushes grime deeper into the wire mesh
selected_script.hook: Extreme close-up of a greasy metal wire splatter screen as a soapy dish brush scrubs it, pushing the sticky yellow oil deeper into the fine mesh instead of cleaning it.

timeline.scene: Extreme close-up: A hand scrubs a greasy fine-mesh wire splatter screen with a soapy dish brush. The yellow grease just gets mashed deeper into the tiny holes, looking messy and frustrating.

The white NUAN spray bottle with its green label enters the frame. The white trigger nozzle sprays a thick, dense white foam directly onto the mesh, instantly melting and lifting the trapped yellow grease.
Fast cut: A blue microfiber cleaning towel wipes cleanly across the mesh in one satisfying swipe, revealing gleaming, perfectly clean metal underneath.
Fast cut: A heavily greased glass stovetop is quickly sprayed with the NUAN foam and wiped effortlessly clean with the blue towel, leaving a flawless reflective surface.
Fast cut: A gloved hand wipes the dissolving NUAN foam off a dirty microwave interior tray, leaving the inside spotless and fresh.
Gentle aesthetic shot of the white and green NUAN spray bottle resting neatly next to the sparkling clean stovetop. Text overlay appears: 'A simple upgrade for everyday use.'
